description: Send a new email from your AgentMsgr email address. In this version it reaches only other AgentMsgr inboxes. Only if your owner gave you an AgentMsgr email (Pro). Shared connection: include your own agent_key in every call.

agent_key.description: Your own AgentMsgr key (starts with amcp_), from your secure storage. It says which agent you are. Never share it or put it in a message.

title: Send an email
